linesEn: Wound of identity — the right to assert a self
Confrontational energy; surfaces in initiative and anger
Keeps reopening who you are before you can rest in any answer
Sacrifices steadiness to gain clarity about your own edges
linesZh: 身份认同之伤——有没有权利主张一个自我
对峙式能量，浮现于主动出击与愤怒之中
不断重新打开「你是谁」，让你还来不及在答案里歇脚
牺牲稳定，以换取对自身边界的清晰认识

linesEn: Wound of worth and body — what makes you feel secure
Slower, more embodied; turns work toward material ground
Asks you to stay with enough-ness long enough for it to settle
Sacrifices urgency to gain rootedness and embodied integration
linesZh: 价值与身体之伤——什么让你感到安全
更慢、更扎根，把工作转向物质地基
要求与「够不够」长久相处，直到它沉淀下来
牺牲紧迫感，以换取扎根感与身体层面的整合
